From c879a8c39dd55e7fabdd8d13341f7bc5200db377 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2024 11:48:47 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] mfd: rsmu: Split core code into separate module

Linking a file into two modules can have unintended side-effects
and produces a W=1 warning:

scripts/Makefile.build:236: drivers/mfd/Makefile: rsmu_core.o is added to multiple modules: rsmu-i2c rsmu-spi

Make this one a separate module instead.

Fixes: a1867f85e06e ("mfd: Add Renesas Synchronization Management Unit (SMU) support")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240529094856.1869543-1-arnd@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Lee Jones <lee@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/mfd/Makefile b/drivers/mfd/Makefile
index ce38d643009f..02b651cd7535 100644
--- a/drivers/mfd/Makefile
+++ b/drivers/mfd/Makefile
@@ -286,7 +286,5 @@ obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_INTEL_M10_BMC_PMCI)   += intel-m10-bmc-pmci.o
 obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_ATC260X)	+= atc260x-core.o
 obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_ATC260X_I2C)	+= atc260x-i2c.o
 
-rsmu-i2c-objs			:= rsmu_core.o rsmu_i2c.o
-rsmu-spi-objs			:= rsmu_core.o rsmu_spi.o
-obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_RSMU_I2C)	+= rsmu-i2c.o
-obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_RSMU_SPI)	+= rsmu-spi.o
+obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_RSMU_I2C)	+= rsmu_i2c.o rsmu_core.o
+obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_RSMU_SPI)	+= rsmu_spi.o rsmu_core.o

diff --git a/drivers/mfd/rsmu_core.c b/drivers/mfd/rsmu_core.c
index 29437fd0bd5b..fd04a6e5dfa3 100644
--- a/drivers/mfd/rsmu_core.c
+++ b/drivers/mfd/rsmu_core.c
@@ -78,11 +78,13 @@ int rsmu_core_init(struct rsmu_ddata *rsmu)
 
 	return ret;
 }
+EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(rsmu_core_init);
 
 void rsmu_core_exit(struct rsmu_ddata *rsmu)
 {
 	mutex_destroy(&rsmu->lock);
 }
+EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(rsmu_core_exit);
 
 MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Renesas SMU core driver");
 MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **drivers/mfd/Makefile**
   - Removed the lines that defined `rsmu-i2c-objs` and `rsmu-spi-objs` to include `rsmu_core.o`.
   - Updated the lines for `obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_RSMU_I2C)` and `obj-$(CONFIG_MFD_RSMU_SPI)` to directly include `rsmu_core.o` along with their respective object files (`rsmu_i2c.o` and `rsmu_spi.o`).

2. **drivers/mfd/rsmu_core.c**
   - Added `EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL` for the functions `rsmu_core_init` and `rsmu_core_exit`, allowing these functions to be used by other modules.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The changes in the `Makefile` and `rsmu_core.c` are related in that they facilitate the separation of the `rsmu_core` functionality into its own module. By modifying the `Makefile`, the patch ensures that `rsmu_core.o` is included in both the I2C and SPI modules without causing conflicts, while the `EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL` additions in `rsmu_core.c` allow these core functions to be accessible to other modules that may depend on them. This restructuring addresses the warning about linking a file into multiple modules and improves the modularity of the code.
